name: code-audit
description: Source-only audit: bound scope, parallel security/correctness scans, independent evidence verification and deterministic severity-ranked report. Does not modify code or certify it clean.
whenToUse: Review a repository or bounded change for evidence-backed correctness and security findings without editing files or running commands.

phases.title: scope
phases.detail: Bound requested source scope and record inspection limits

phases.title: scans
phases.detail: Parallel bounded security and correctness scans

phases.title: verify
phases.detail: Independently resolve every candidate and rank the report
